status: DRAFT, proposed, pending vote. Baseline inputs come from the governance-ratified page (Prop 61). Every value under `placeholders` (including budget_cap) is a PLACEHOLDER chosen by the Bounties Coordinator bot; none has been voted on. Amounts are proposals pending a vote and must not be paid.

formula.reward_tokens: reward[asset] = base_rate[asset](h) x base_work_units x tier_multiplier[tier] x priority_multiplier[priority]
formula.base_rate: base_rate[asset](h) = 1 / baseline_price[asset](h): tokens per work unit, where one work unit is the value the baseline assigns to one verified block ($1 at the reference point)
formula.baseline_price: baseline_price[asset](h) = V(h) / supply[asset](h), rounded to 5 decimal places (the page's rounding)
formula.network_value: V(h) = (h - missed_blocks) x verified_block_value + missed_blocks x missed_block_value
formula.stipend: stipend[asset] per month = base_rate[asset](h) x stipend_work_units_per_month[band]
formula.h: the listing height. The amount is fixed when the bounty is listed and recorded together with h and params_version. See placeholders.recompute_rule.

ratified_by.title: text proposal: yesterday's price isnt todays price
ratified_by.note: Prop 61 ratifies the page as 'the working baseline for coordinating negotiations for the initial coordination of funds' and the 'non-negotiable starting point for initial token pricing discussions, bootstrapping negotiations with external parties, and internal treasury valuation'. It says 'a floor for those talks, not a market price'. Using it to price bounty payouts is an application this file proposes; see placeholders.apply_baseline_to_bounties.

verified_block_value_usd.cite: baseline page, section 'Method': 'A verified block counts $1 (1,318 sats at the reference time).'

missed_block_value_usd.cite: baseline page, section 'Method': 'The 6,641,532 missed blocks ... count $0.67 each: a one-third penalty.'

missed_blocks.cite: baseline page, sections 'Method' and 'Reference point' ('16,596,620 verified, 6,641,532 missed')

token_baseline_formula.value: TERP = V(h) / TERP supply at h; THIOL = V(h) / THIOL supply at h

baseline_rises_per_block.cite: baseline page, section 'Method': 'The baseline rises with every new block: yesterday's prices are not today's prices.'

price_rounding_decimals.cite: baseline page, section 'Initial baseline': 'Values are rounded to five decimal places.'

initial_baseline.cite: baseline page, section 'Initial baseline' and the summary table ('Initial · 15 Sep 2026')

TERP.cite: denom from on-chain bank supply (catalog/pricing-snapshot/supply-uterp-23908167.json). The chain has no denom metadata for uterp (denoms_metadata returns code 5), so exponent 6 is derived: the page's TERP supply 419,894,441.995 matches the on-chain uterp supply / 10^6 at that scale.

THIOL.cite: as for TERP, from supply-uthiol-23908167.json; the page's THIOL supply 891,626,585.813 matches uthiol / 10^6.

snapshot.note: Inputs for the indicative amounts printed in the catalog. Fetched from api.terp.network on 2026-10-18 with x-cosmos-block-height pinned to the same height. At listing, recompute at the listing height.

placeholders._label: PLACEHOLDER: not voted. Each needs a governance (or DAO) decision before any amount is paid.

apply_baseline_to_bounties.needs_vote: Adopt the Prop 61 baseline (one work unit = one verified-block value) as the conversion for bounty payouts in TERP and THIOL. Prop 61's stated scope is pricing discussions, negotiations and treasury valuation; it does not name bounty payouts.

base_work_units.needs_vote: Size of one T1 unit (work units = $1-equivalent verified blocks at the baseline).

tier_multiplier.needs_vote: Per-tier multipliers. Chosen so that base x multiplier (100 / 300 / 1,000 / 3,000 / 9,000 work units) sits inside the catalog v1 draft USD bands. Those bands were never voted either.

priority_multiplier.needs_vote: Urgency multipliers, carried over from the catalog v1 draft (P0 x1.5 while the incident is open, P1 x1.2 inside the window).

stipend_work_units_per_month.needs_vote: Monthly stipend sizes. Set inside the catalog v1 draft R1-R3 bands.

stipend_holdback_pct.needs_vote: Holdback released at the 12-month report (from the relayer plan draft).

multiplier_cap.needs_vote: Combined multipliers (priority, partner match, upstream bonus) never exceed this factor of the tier amount.

upstream_bonus.needs_vote: +10% when merged upstream or accepted by a partner.

partner_match_max_ratio.needs_vote: Terp may match partner co-funding up to 1:1.

retro_max_fraction.needs_vote: Retroactive awards up to 100% of the computed amount.

asset_policy.value: per-bounty choice of TERP or THIOL at listing; the catalog prints both
asset_policy.needs_vote: Which asset pays which bounty, or a fixed TERP/THIOL split, and from which treasury (community pool vs Foundation DAO).

recompute_rule.value: fix at listing height h; re-list (new h) if the baseline price moves more than 20% or the bounty is unclaimed for 7 days
recompute_rule.needs_vote: When to recompute amounts as the baseline rises. The 20%/7-day rule is the bounty-amounts.md draft rule, not voted.

severity_scaling.value: TB-SEC-001 tier set by confirmed severity (T2..T5)
severity_scaling.needs_vote: Severity-to-tier map for the standing bug bounty.

budget_cap.label: PLACEHOLDER (not voted): Now-set cap = 25% of a yearly budget of 0.5% of THIOL supply
rule: yearly_budget_THIOL(h) = yearly_budget_fraction_of_supply x THIOL supply at h (0.5%; basis: priority-ranking-v2.md 'Bounty budget' row, which resizes econ-dex-proxy-analysis.md's '~0.5% of the treasury' to THIOL supply)
cap_THIOL(h) = share_for_scope x yearly_budget_THIOL(h)  (25% of that yearly budget for the Now set)
cap_work_units(h) = cap_THIOL(h) x baseline_price[THIOL](h)  (1 work unit = $1 of baseline value, so the cap is the same value whichever asset pays)
raw_Now_work_units = sum over Now items of base_work_units x tier_multiplier x priority_multiplier (one-off amounts; stipends are counted separately)
every item's work units (and stipend work units) are multiplied by k before conversion to tokens (apply_scale_to = all, so a T3 in Next is not worth more than a T3 in Now); micro amounts are floored
invariant checked at build: sum of Now THIOL amounts <= cap_THIOL and sum of Now TERP amounts <= cap_work_units / baseline_price[TERP]
budget_cap.needs_vote: Total bounty budget and the Now-set share (TB-GOV-001). No envelope has been voted; 0.5% of supply and the 25% share are placeholders.

implementation_choices._label: Technical, not policy. No vote needed, but listed so they can be reviewed.
implementation_choices.amount_rounding: floor to whole micro-denom; display with 2 decimals of the whole token
implementation_choices.price_used: the 5-decimal rounded baseline price (as the page publishes it)
